title: Smoke Blankets Borneo
credit: NASA Earth Observatory / Joshua Stevens; Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey. Article by Adam Voiland.
interpretation: NASA describes active fires in southern Borneo, highlighted with shortwave-infrared bands 7-6-2 over natural-color bands 4-3-2.
supports: An actual fire episode in southern Borneo during September 2019
A separate instrument observes active fires during the calendar episode
does_not_support: Independent accuracy of our regional count or adjusted magnitude
A georeferenced fire perimeter or burned-area estimate
Proof that every hotspot is vegetation fire
Fire-free conditions in the comparison year
date_note: The article download list labels the Landsat image September 15; the filename day-of-year 258 also corresponds to September 15. The 2025 upload path is a website migration date, not the observation date.
